metadata.name: envdoctor
metadata.summary: Validate .env keys against .env.example — catch missing config before deploy
metadata.description:
# envdoctor

**Catch missing `.env` keys before they hit production.**

Compares your `.env` to `.env.example` and reports what’s missing (or extra).

[![CI](https://github.com/kianPk/envdoctor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kianPk/envdoctor/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9+-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

## Install

```bash
pip install .
# or from source
pip install .
```

## Usage

```bash
envdoctor
envdoctor -e .env.local -x .env.example
envdoctor --strict          # exit 2 on extra keys not in example
envdoctor --json            # JSON report for scripts / CI
```

### Example output

```text
example: .env.example (12 keys)
env:     .env (10 keys)

missing in .env (required by example):
  - DATABASE_URL
  - JWT_SECRET
```

Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` missing required keys, `2` extra keys (with `--strict`) or file errors.

```yaml
- run: envdoctor --strict
```

## License

MIT © [kianPk](https://github.com/kianPk)
